Package com.inventory.service

Class InventoryManager

java.lang.Object
com.inventory.service.InventoryManager
public class InventoryManager extends Object
Service class that coordinates and executes core business logic and CRUD operations for the Inventory Management System.

Responsibilities include:

  • Adding new inventory items with unique auto-incremented identifiers, category, pricing, and validation.
  • Retrieving all items or querying specific items by ID, name, or category.
  • Modifying existing items while handling non-existent updates gracefully.
  • Removing items safely by ID.
  • Monitoring stock level thresholds (In Stock, Low Stock, Out of Stock).
  • Calculating total inventory valuation (Net Worth).
  • Exporting inventory data to CSV reports.
Version:
2.0
Author:
Muhammad Hassan
